TrackerLens looks inside your apps for the code of %1$d known ad, analytics and tracking services. It has no Internet permission and no ads or analytics, so your app list stays on your phone.

A match shows the code is in the app, not that it is active or sending data. It does not mean the app is malicious, and many apps use these services for ordinary reasons.

No match does not prove an app is free of trackers. Renamed code, native code, code downloaded later and services outside the list stay hidden.

Results are kept on the phone so unchanged apps are not scanned again. TrackerLens only sees the current profile, so a work profile needs its own copy.
